$description: Slider (platform/components/Slider), library wave 6, lane C: the tokens of the track it draws for a range slider (two thumbs) and a slider with marks. The plain slider stays the browser's control on the shared Slider tokens (components.tokens.json); this track repeats its look with the same roles: the action color for the filled part and the thumbs.

slider-track-height.$description: Range or marked slider: the track's thickness.

slider-track-radius.$description: Range or marked slider: the track's and the fill's round ends.

slider-track-background.$description: Range or marked slider: the track outside the chosen part (the default border role).

slider-fill-background.$description: Range or marked slider: the chosen part of the track (the plain slider's accent color).

slider-thumb-size.$description: Range or marked slider: the thumb's width and height (a circle).

slider-thumb-radius.$description: Range or marked slider: the thumb's corners (a circle).

slider-thumb-background.$description: Range or marked slider: the thumb's fill (the plain slider's accent color).

slider-thumb-top-layer.$description: Range slider: lifts the minimum's input above the maximum's when the thumbs meet near the end, so it can still be dragged.

slider-mark-text.$description: Slider mark: the label's color (the value's).

slider-mark-font-family.$description: Slider mark: a value, in the data font.

slider-mark-font-size.$description: Slider mark: the label's size (the value's).

slider-mark-line-height.$description: Slider mark: the label's line, and the height of the row of marks under the track.
